candidates.summary: Daemon/frontend TLS trust and Dockerfile RUN TLS trust are distinct validation boundaries.
candidates.evidence: Both unchanged production Dockerfiles failed go mod download with unknown authority after successful frontend/base pulls. A separate synthetic CA-secret RUN reached the same dependency URL and exported a descriptor-valid OCI. See test-report.txt and measurements.json; application OCI remains unverified.
candidates.scope: A measured proxy/CA environment boundary; not a general product defect, source change recommendation, new permission or application build success.
